// PQ Lint
.alter function with (
    docstring = 'Add PQLint Tests',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParsePQLintTest()
{
    pq_lint_bronze
    | extend raw = todynamic(Results)                           // safe parse; null on bad JSON
    | extend jsonData = case(
        isnotnull(array_length(raw)), raw,                      // already an array
        isnull(raw), dynamic([]),                               // bad/empty JSON → empty array (skip)
        pack_array(raw)                                         // single object → wrap into array
    )
    | mv-expand element = jsonData
    | where isnotnull(element) and not(isnull(element.ID))                                   // drop any nulls
    | project 
        ID = element.ID,
        Name = tostring(element.Name),
        Description = tostring(element.Description)
    | extend 
        BusinessKey = strcat('PQLINT_',ID),
        Source = 'PQ Lint'
    | project 
        Id = hash(BusinessKey),
        BusinessKey,
        Name,
        Description,
        Source
}

.alter table
[pq_lint_tests_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "pq_lint_bronze", "Query": "fnParsePQLintTest", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

// PBIR Inspector

.alter function with (
    docstring = 'Add PBIR Inspector Tests',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParsePBIRInspectorTest()
{
    pbir_inspector_bronze
    | extend jsonData = parse_json(Results)   // Convert to dynamic (JSON object/array)
    | mv-expand element = jsonData             // Split array into one row per element
    | project 
        BusinessKey = strcat('PBIRInspector_',tostring(element.RuleId)),
        Name        = tostring(element.RuleName),
        Description = tostring(element.RuleDescription),
        Source      = "PBIR Inspector"
    | project 
        Id = hash(BusinessKey),
        BusinessKey,
        Name,
        Description,
        Source
}

.alter table
[pbir_inspector_tests_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "pbir_inspector_bronze", "Query": "fnParsePBIRInspectorTest", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

.create function with (
    docstring = 'Add Tabular Editor Tests',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParseTabularEditorTest()
{
    tabular_editor_bronze
    | extend CleanXml = replace(@"<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>", "", tostring(Results))
    | extend parsed = parse_xml(CleanXml)
    | extend TestDefinitions = parsed.TestRun.TestDefinitions.UnitTest
    | mv-expand TestDefinitions
    | extend
        UnitTestId = tostring(TestDefinitions['@id']),
        UnitTestName = tostring(TestDefinitions['@name']),
        Properties = TestDefinitions.Properties.Property
    | mv-expand Properties
    | extend
        Key = tostring(Properties.Key),
        Value = tostring(Properties.Value)
    | where Key in ('RuleID', 'Description')
    | summarize PropertiesMap = make_bag(pack(Key, Value)) by UnitTestId, UnitTestName
    | extend 
        BusinessKey = strcat('TabularEditor_',PropertiesMap.RuleID)
    | project Id = hash(BusinessKey), BusinessKey, Name = UnitTestName, Description = PropertiesMap.Description, Source = 'Tabular Editor'
}

.alter table
[tabular_editor_tests_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "tabular_editor_bronze", "Query": "fnParseTabularEditorTest", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

.create table [pbir_inspector_test_results_silver] (Id: long, CommitsId: long, TestsId: long, SeverityId: int, Actual: string, Expected: string, Details: string, Passed: int, Date: datetime, Time: timespan)
.create table [pq_lint_test_results_silver] (Id: long, CommitsId: long, TestsId: long, SeverityId: int, Actual: string, Expected: string, Details: string, Passed: int, Date: datetime, Time: timespan)
.create table [tabular_editor_test_results_silver] (Id: long, CommitsId: long, TestsId: long, SeverityId: int, Actual: string, Expected: string, Details: string, Passed: int, Date: datetime, Time: timespan)

// PBIR Inspector
.alter function with (
    docstring = 'Add Test Results from PBIR Inspector',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParsePBIRInspectorTestResults()
{
pbir_inspector_bronze
| extend jsonData = parse_json(Results)   // Convert to dynamic (JSON object/array)
| mv-expand element = jsonData             // Split array into one row per element
| project 
    CommitsId = hash(strcat(RepositoryId, CommitId, BranchName, LogicalId, ReportName, 'Report')),
    TestsId = hash(strcat('PBIRInspector_', tostring(element.RuleId))),
    // 1 is warning, 2 is Error, and else we do 1 as informational
    SeverityId = toint(case(tostring(element.Type) == '1', 2, tostring(element.Type) == '2', 3, 1)),
    Expected = tostring(element.Expected),
    Actual = tostring(element.Actual),
    Details = strcat(element.ItemPath, ': ',element.Message),
    Passed = toint(case(tostring(element.Pass) == 'true', 1, 0)),
    TSYear = toint(substring(Timestamp, 0, 4)),
    TSMonth = toint(substring(Timestamp, 4, 2)),
    TSDay = toint(substring(Timestamp, 6, 2)),
    TSHour = toint(substring(Timestamp, 9, 2)),
    TSMinute = toint(substring(Timestamp, 11, 2)),
    TSSecond = toint(substring(Timestamp, 13, 2))
| extend 
    Date = todatetime(strcat(TSYear,'-',TSMonth,'-',TSDay,' 00:00:00Z')),
    Time = totimespan(strcat(TSHour, ":", TSMinute, ":", TSSecond))
| project
    Id = hash(strcat(CommitsId, TestsId, tostring(Date), tostring(Time))),
    CommitsId,
    TestsId,
    SeverityId,
    Actual,
    Expected,
    Details,
    Passed,
    Date,
    Time
}

.alter table
[pbir_inspector_test_results_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "pbir_inspector_bronze", "Query": "fnParsePBIRInspectorTestResults()", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

// PQ Lint
.alter function with (
    docstring = 'Add Test Results from PQ Lint',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParsePQLintTestResults()
{
    pq_lint_bronze
    | extend raw = todynamic(Results)                           // safe parse; null on bad JSON
    | extend jsonData = case(
        isnotnull(array_length(raw)), raw,                      // already an array
        isnull(raw), dynamic([]),                               // bad/empty JSON → empty array (skip)
        pack_array(raw)                                         // single object → wrap into array
    )
    | mv-expand element = jsonData
    | where element != '{}'                                   // drop any nulls
    | project 
    CommitsId = hash(strcat(RepositoryId, CommitId, BranchName, LogicalId, SemanticModelName, 'Semantic Model')),
    TestsId = hash(strcat('PQLINT_',element.ID)),
    // 1 is warning, 2 is Error, and else we do 1 as informational
    SeverityId = toint(element.Severity),
    Expected = tostring('Pass'),
    Actual = iff(element.Passed == 'true','Pass','Fail'),
    Details = '',
    Passed = toint(iff(element.Passed == 'true',1,0)),
    TSYear = toint(substring(Timestamp, 0, 4)),
    TSMonth = toint(substring(Timestamp, 4, 2)),
    TSDay = toint(substring(Timestamp, 6, 2)),
    TSHour = toint(substring(Timestamp, 9, 2)),
    TSMinute = toint(substring(Timestamp, 11, 2)),
    TSSecond = toint(substring(Timestamp, 13, 2)),
    TmdlFileName
| extend 
    Date = todatetime(strcat(TSYear,'-',TSMonth,'-',TSDay,' 00:00:00Z')),
    Time = totimespan(strcat(TSHour, ":", TSMinute, ":", TSSecond))
| project
    Id = hash(strcat(CommitsId, TestsId, tostring(Date), tostring(Time))),
    CommitsId,
    TestsId,
    SeverityId,
    Actual,
    Expected,
    Details = TmdlFileName,
    Passed,
    Date,
    Time
}

.alter table
[pq_lint_test_results_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "pq_lint_bronze", "Query": "fnParsePQLintTestResults()", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

// Tabular Editor
.alter function with (
    docstring = 'Add Test Results from Tabular Editor',
    folder = 'Bronze to Silver'
) fnParseTabularEditorTestResults()
    {
    // ---- Test Definitions ----
    let Definitions = 
    tabular_editor_bronze
    | extend CleanXml = replace(@"<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>", "", tostring(Results))
    | extend parsed = parse_xml(CleanXml)
    | extend TestDefinitions = parsed.TestRun.TestDefinitions.UnitTest
    | mv-expand TestDefinitions
    | extend
        UnitTestId = tostring(TestDefinitions['@id']),
        UnitTestName = tostring(TestDefinitions['@name']),
        Properties = TestDefinitions.Properties.Property
    | mv-expand Properties
    | extend
        Key = tostring(Properties.Key),
        Value = tostring(Properties.Value)
    | where Key in ('RuleID', 'Description','Severity')
    | summarize PropertiesMap = make_bag(pack(Key, Value)) by UnitTestId, UnitTestName
    | extend 
        BusinessKey = strcat('TabularEditor_', PropertiesMap.RuleID),
        Severity = PropertiesMap.Severity
    | project 
        UnitTestId,
        TestId = hash(BusinessKey),
        BusinessKey,
        Name = UnitTestName,
        Description = PropertiesMap.Description,
        Severity,
        Source = 'Tabular Editor';

    // ---- Test Entries ----
    let TestEntries =
    tabular_editor_bronze
    | extend CleanXml = replace(@"<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>", "", tostring(Results))
    | extend parsed = parse_xml(CleanXml)
    | extend TestEntries = parsed.TestRun.TestEntries
    | mv-expand TestEntries
    | mv-expand TestEntries.TestEntry
    | project     
        UnitTestId = tostring(TestEntries_TestEntry['@testId']),
        ExecutionId = tostring(TestEntries_TestEntry['@executionId']);


    // ---- Test Results ----
    let Results =
    tabular_editor_bronze
    | extend CleanXml = replace(@"<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>", "", tostring(Results))
    | extend parsed = parse_xml(CleanXml),
        TSYear = toint(substring(Timestamp, 0, 4)),
        TSMonth = toint(substring(Timestamp, 4, 2)),
        TSDay = toint(substring(Timestamp, 6, 2)),
        TSHour = toint(substring(Timestamp, 9, 2)),
        TSMinute = toint(substring(Timestamp, 11, 2)),
        TSSecond = toint(substring(Timestamp, 13, 2))
    | extend 
        CommitsId = hash(strcat(RepositoryId, CommitId, BranchName, LogicalId, SemanticModelName, 'Semantic Model')),
        Date = todatetime(strcat(TSYear,'-',TSMonth,'-',TSDay,' 00:00:00Z')),
        Time = totimespan(strcat(TSHour, ":", TSMinute, ":", TSSecond))
    | extend TestResults = parsed.TestRun.Results.UnitTestResult
    | mv-expand TestResults
    | mv-expand TestResults.Output
    | extend
        UnitTestId = tostring(TestResults['@testId']),
        Outcome = tostring(TestResults['@outcome']),
        TestName = tostring(TestResults['@testName']),
        Message = TestResults_Output.ErrorInfo.Message,
        StackTrace = TestResults_Output.ErrorInfo.StackTrace,
        ExecutionId = tostring(TestResults['@executionId'])
    | project 
        ExecutionId,
        CommitsId,
        UnitTestId,
        Actual = Outcome,
        Expected = 'Passed',
        Details = strcat(Message, '. ', StackTrace),
        Passed = toint(iff(Outcome == 'Passed', 1, 0)),
        Date,
        Time;

    // ---- Join Definitions with Results ----
    Results
    | join kind=inner TestEntries on $left.ExecutionId == $right.ExecutionId and $left.UnitTestId == $right.UnitTestId
    | join kind=inner Definitions on $left.UnitTestId == $right.UnitTestId
    | project 
        Id = hash(strcat(ExecutionId, tostring(Date), tostring(Time))), 
        CommitsId, 
        TestsId = TestId,
        SeverityId = toint(Severity), 
        Actual,
        Expected,
        Details,
        Passed,
        Date, 
        Time
}

.alter table
[tabular_editor_test_results_silver]
policy update @'[{"Source": "tabular_editor_bronze", "Query": "fnParseTabularEditorTestResults()", "IsEnabled" : true, "IsTransactional": true }]'

    CommitsId, 
    TestsId = hash(BusinessKey),
    SeverityId = toint(Severity), 
    Actual,
    Expected,
    Details,
    Passed,
    Date, 
    Time
tabs.title: Tabular Editor

tabs.content:
range Date from toscalar(Commits | where Date >= ago(5d) | summarize min(Date)) to now() step 1d
| extend 
    Day = dayofmonth(Date),
    Month = getmonth(Date),
    Year = getyear(Date),
    MonthName = case(
        getmonth(Date) == 1, "January",
        getmonth(Date) == 2, "February",
        getmonth(Date) == 3, "March",
        getmonth(Date) == 4, "April",
        getmonth(Date) == 5, "May",
        getmonth(Date) == 6, "June",
        getmonth(Date) == 7, "July",
        getmonth(Date) == 8, "August",
        getmonth(Date) == 9, "September",
        getmonth(Date) == 10, "October",
        getmonth(Date) == 11, "November",
        getmonth(Date) == 12, "December",
        "Unknown"
    ),
    MonthYearYYYYMM = getyear(Date) * 100 + getmonth(Date),
    CalendarID = toint(format_datetime(Date, 'yyyyMMdd'))
| project CalendarID, Date, Day, Month, MonthName, MonthYearYYYYMM, Year

TestResults
| join kind=inner (
    Commits
    | where BranchName == "dev"
      and RepositoryId == "61fb66b0-81ca-43a4-8627-aaef69824465"
) on $left.CommitsId == $right.Id
| where SeverityId == 3 
| join kind=inner (
    Tests
) on $left.TestsId == $right.Id
| extend RunDateTime = todatetime(Date) + totimespan(strcat("0.", Time))
| summarize arg_max(RunDateTime, *) by ArtifactName, Type, Source, TestsId
| project ArtifactName, Type, Source, TestName = Name, TestDescription = Description, Details, Passed, RunDateTime
| where Passed == 0
| order by ArtifactName, Type, Source
